Title: TexTrolls: Identifying Russian Trolls on Twitter from a Textual Perspective
Therefore, in this paper, we propose a text-based approach to detect the online trolls such as those that were discovered during the US 2016 presidential elections. Our approach is mainly based on textual features which uti- lize thematic information, and proﬁling features to identify the accounts from their way of writing tweets. We deduced the thematic information in a unsupervised way and we show that coupling them with the textual features enhanced the performance of the proposed model.

This result emphasizes the importance of the thematic information.

Title: TexTrolls: Identifying Russian Trolls on Twitter from a Textual Perspective
We study the eﬀect of a set of text-based features and we propose a machine learning model to detect them7. We aim to answer three research questions: RQ1. Does the thematic information improve the detection performance?, RQ2. Can we detect IRA trolls from only a textual perspective? and RQ3. How IRA campaign utilized the emotions to aﬀect the public opinions?

The authors state they "applied a topic modeling algorithm to go behind the superficial textual information of the tweets" [9], and that the thematic information was deduced "in a unsupervised way" [1]. However, the specific topic modeling technique (e.g., its name or algorithmic family) is not identified in the supplied passages, so this cannot be determined from the given evidence.
